app.tokenMissingBefore: The server never handed me a session token. Check that
app.tokenMissingAfter: is running, then reload this page.

reader.empty: Pick a node in the tree on the left, or hit Ctrl+K to search.
reader.linkOutsideVault: this link leaves the vault — it is not followed
reader.brokenLink: broken link — {path} does not exist in the vault

shelf.removeConfirm: Remove "{title}" from this notebook? The node itself is untouched.
shelf.dropHint: drag nodes from the tree (on the left) anywhere in here to add them to the notebook.

graph.title: graph
graph.colorOnHint: every node takes its first tag's colour (map from Settings)
graph.colorOffHint: nodes in the Mind accent, tags in white
graph.revealHintAtOnce: the graph comes back all at once

terminal.label: Terminal
terminal.popOut: Pop out into a floating window
terminal.poppedBody: This session is floating in its own window.
terminal.onTopOn: Staying above other windows — click to let it go behind
terminal.onTopOff: Click to keep it above other windows
terminal.offBody: The embedded terminal is off. It runs a shell (by default, Claude Code) in your vault's folder — turn it on in Settings if you want it.

noVault.title: No notes here yet
noVault.body: MindView found no Markdown files under {path}.
noVault.cloneIntro: Don't have a Mind vault? Clone the template into a folder:
noVault.thenPick: Then point MindView at that folder:

settings.accentHint: buttons, selection, active links — the default is the Mind green
settings.linkColorHint: leave blank to use the accent colour
settings.languageHint: 'Automatic' follows your browser; the vault's own content is never translated
settings.typographyHint: affects only the content you read — sidebar, terminal and navigation stay on Inter/JetBrains Mono.
settings.tagColorsHint: every tag found in the vault, most-used first. Used in the reader, the shelf and the graph. A tag you haven't coloured uses the app's text colour.
settings.tagColorsEmpty: no tags in this vault yet — they show up here as soon as a note has `tags:` in its frontmatter
settings.extColorsHint: every file type found in the vault besides notes. The colour shows on the file's badge in the tree and on its node in the graph; without one, it stays grey.
settings.frontmatterPrettyHint: tags as pills + formatted dates, instead of raw YAML
settings.terminalEnabledHint: off by default: with it on, the app can open a shell on this machine. Ctrl+` opens and closes the panel.
settings.terminalEnableConfirm: This lets MindView run an interactive shell on your machine — only enable it if you know what that means. Turn it on?
settings.shellHint: detected on {platform}; leave blank for this machine's default
settings.shellPathHint: for a shell that is not in the list above
settings.modeCommandHint: runs only the command below; quitting it ends the session, with no prompt underneath
settings.modeShellHint: full terminal: quitting the command gives the shell prompt back
settings.startupCommandHintCommand: the shell is replaced by it — blank = plain shell
settings.startupCommandHintShell: typed into the shell as soon as it starts — blank = plain shell
settings.backupHint: notebooks, theme and tag colours live only on this machine — no repository, no cloud. Export now and then so you do not lose them if you reinstall the app or change machines.
settings.backupConfirm: Importing this backup replaces ALL current notebooks, theme, tag colours and pins. Continue?
settings.vaultHint: folder of the vault to read. Pick it with the button, or type/paste the path — Windows paths work too (C:\… or \\wsl.localhost\…).

vaultError.empty: type the path of a folder
vaultError.notAbsolute: use a full path — with the drive letter on Windows (C:\…) or starting with / on Linux
vaultError.otherDistro: that folder is in a different WSL distro from the one MindView runs in — pick one from the same distro or from Windows
vaultError.network: network folders are not accepted — map it to a drive letter (e.g. Z:) in Explorer and pick that

asset.otherDesktop: MindView can't show this type of file — open it in its own app, or find it in its folder.
asset.otherBlocked: MindView can't show this type of file. It could run something when opened, so it isn't opened from here — find it in its folder and open it yourself if you mean to.
asset.otherBrowser: MindView can't show this type of file — download it to open it.
asset.tooBig: this file is {size} — too big to show here
